optimizedDescription.value: ArchiveChange atomically preflights, publishes, archives, restores on commit failure, then reports nonfatal post-archive failures.

optimizedContext.value:
# ArchiveChange

## Rules
- Inject repositories, registries, `archiveBindings`, reconciler, metadata materializer, actor, snapshot, hashing; no `RunStepHooks`/`HookRunner`.
- `execute({ name, skipChecks })` accepts only resolved skippable checks; aliases map to checks. Predicates always run.
- Accept `archivable|archiving`; reconcile fresh facts and predicate preflight before effects, snapshots, or writes.
- Fully prepare merged artifacts, deps, state, locks, implementation links and validations; snapshot batch; enter `archiving` immediately before publish.
- Commit failure restores all snapshots and returns `archivable` only after restoration. Publish preserves optimizations; archive persists actor.
- Metadata and post-effects failures report nonfatally. Bypassed overlap reconciles peers with `spec-overlap-conflict`.

## Constraints
- No hooks, snapshots, or writes before `change.assertArchivable()`.
- Preflight/snapshots precede state change/publication.
- Successful archive never rolls back for post-publish failures.
